newsitem.title: USA: Cronus dissolves Black Diamond merger.
newsitem.headline: Cronus dissolves Black Diamond merger.

text.p: Cronus Corp on Monday said it had dissolved its merger with Black Diamond Mining Corp.
In a statement, the company said the agreement, which was executed July 8, was reversed December 20.
Cronus officials reached by telephone said the merger was dissolved because the companies could not resolve their differences, but they would not be more specific.
In the statement, Cronus said it would retain the Black Diamond and Gila mining claims acquired during the association with Black Diamond Mining and all previous assets.
James Ashpole, owner of Black Diamond Mining, has returned to treasury 13,070,074 shares of common stock that were part of the original merger pact.
Currently, Cronus has 10,567,762 issued and outstanding shares, of which only 5,423,762 are free trading.
